STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHARLOTTE.title: Charlotte
Charlotte
STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHARLOTTE.descr:
A journalist of The Steambird from Fontaine.
Carrying her beloved Kamera "Monsieur Verite", she set out for the tower, sniffing out a big story.

Freezes moments with [gold]Snapshots[/gold], exposes the truth with [gold]Focus[/gold], and records every corner of the Spire with [gold]News[/gold].
STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHARLOTTE.besti: Then let's set off! We're going to be the first paper with a finished story!
